set.body:
Outcome

Rebuild modules/image as a neuroimaging policy API over one image4s Sampled that owns one Ravel NDArray, with image4s-locus and locus4s owning exact voxel and parcel domains. Remove preservation of historical first-axis-fastest Array and linear ordinal behavior. Closed children already attached to this epic remain baseline migration evidence, not the final architecture.

Layer ownership

- Ravel owns dense storage, rank, shape, strides, immutable views, builders, and generic kernels.
- image4s owns grids, sample spaces, axes, metadata, value semantics, and image-aware views.
- image4s-locus and locus4s own canonical grid domains, Index, Region, Selection, fields, and atlas maps.
- reframe4s owns generic transforms and resampling execution.
- ScalaFIM owns neuroimaging vocabulary, algorithms, I/O policy, and checked refinements only.

Core contracts

- Dense volume and series types are zero-wrapper checked Sampled refinements and retain Continuous, Categorical, or Mask semantics. No universal ScalaFimValues escape tag remains.
- Ravel C order, row-major-last-axis-fastest, is the only logical materialized order. Coordinate access and exact typed domain-index access are public; CanonicalArray.readLinear is kernel-only.
- Immutable strided views are valid images. Whole-canonical or workload-prepared storage is an explicit capability, and every materialization is named.
- Sparse data is an ordered locus4s Selection plus compact Ravel storage shaped selection-position first and trailing non-spatial axes after it, for example (voxel,time).
- Dense masks, domain Regions, categorical label images, atlas PartialSurjection values, and parcel fields remain distinct representations with explicit conversions.
- NIfTI and mutable Scala arrays are external copy and layout boundaries, not alternate in-memory ordinal systems.

Acceptance

- Legacy fromLinear, copyLegacyLinear, ambiguous linear(Int), compensating VolumeOrdinalBridge behavior, duplicate ROI and domain containers, copied slice ownership, and hidden Array staging are removed from production APIs.
- Canonical series can reshape to (nVoxels,nTime) without copying when whole canonical; view-safe paths retain zero-copy crop, flip, stride, and time selection.
- Exact grid and parcel identity rejects same-sized foreign owners unless supplied explicit certified alignment.
- Asymmetric 2x3x5x7 coordinate and ordinal oracles, semantic compile tests, allocation receipts, NIfTI round trips, JVM and Scala.js focused suites, compileAll and testAll, downstream consumers, and workload benchmarks all pass.

Non-goals

No source, binary, or ordinal compatibility promise; no parallel multidimensional array hierarchy; no forced eager packing of every image; no second generic domain, field, region, selection, atlas, or registry algebra.
set.title: EPIC: Rebuild ScalaFIM image data structures on native Ravel semantics
